authorization: User approved reference-led complete-building opaque surface comparisons and photo-attached wall distances on 2026-10-27.
roof_crop_rule: The fixed footprint containing the original section midpoint, buffered by 0.5 m. Keep existing triangles whose three vertices are inside this XY support, at all existing source heights. Identical spatial rule, no new fit, decimation, smoothing, filling or registration. ALS uses the existing registered TIN; MVS uses the already-existing training-depth-only TSDF mesh a.
roof_highlight_rule: The previous fixed section-neighborhood XY bounds, restricted to actual displayed triangles with abs(normal.Z) >= 0.7. The accent means same comparison area, not an inferred change mask or physical roof boundary. Both sources use the same mask and neutral surface shading elsewhere.
roof_photo_rule: Original R6 native photograph and calibration, no synthetic pixels. Rotate 90 degrees and fit the entire native photograph to retain context. A leader identifies the existing section midpoint; no filled material mask.
wall_selection: Retain the exact Task0 selected component, patches and best native photo. Only patches with finite per_view_signed in this exact photo are shown: the original global visibility and solid-occluder gates are inherited. No other patches or unknown pixels are filled.
wall_values: Compare prior_abs and mvs_abs at the same retained patches. mvs_abs is the existing median of absolute wall-normal distances across valid training views, not the error of the displayed photograph alone. Both use the existing current UAS reference layer; no new same-surface claim.
wall_support: Each patch is its 0.25 m tangent square centered on the original GT representative point, projected by the calibrated native camera. This is measured patch support, not a full-image dense error mask. Alpha 0.82; no interpolation or dilation.
crs: EPSG:25832 source; existing local coordinates retained
display_changes_allowed: Camera, layout, leader placement and shading only; retain original and revised render plus review. Selection, measurements and source coordinates remain fixed.
